The `DateRangePicker` is composed using accessible and modular [Reka-UI](https://www.reka-ui.com) components:

- [`<Popover />`](/docs/components/popover)
- [`<DateRangePickerRoot />`](https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/components/date-range-picker)
- [`<DateRangePickerCalendar />`](/docs/components/calendar)
